description:
Welcome to Fire Safe People TV. We decode exactly how homes ignite and show you how to protect your property before the next firestorm arrives. Through real front-line fire reporting, home makeovers, and expert breakdowns, we look at the critical details that make a house stand alone, from clearing Zone Zero landscaping to installing ember-resistant vents.

Our mission is to show that being wildfire-prepared is the new curb appeal. You can make your home safe, stylish, and practical while satisfying high-risk insurance requirements. Subscribe to learn how to think like an ember, protect your family legacy, and safeguard your entire neighborhood community.
